title: Malicious code in @beloved-lenora/opencode-stats (npm)
description: The npm package @beloved-lenora/opencode-stats contains malicious code that can fully compromise any computer on which it is installed or running. The compromise may lead to unauthorized access to secrets and keys stored on the affected system. Removal of the package alone does not guarantee elimination of all malicious software introduced by it. Immediate rotation of all secrets and keys from a separate, uncompromised device is strongly recommended.
aiSummary: The @beloved-lenora/opencode-stats npm package is identified as containing malicious code capable of fully compromising the host computer. According to the source details, installation or execution of this package grants an attacker full control over the system, potentially exposing all stored secrets and keys. Due to the depth of compromise, simply uninstalling the package may not remove all malicious artifacts or backdoors introduced. The advisory strongly recommends rotating all secrets and keys from a different, secure machine to mitigate ongoing risk.
aiImpact: Full system compromise on any computer with the package installed or running. Exposure and potential theft of all secrets and keys stored on the system. Persistent malicious presence may remain even after package removal.
